key: ["The age of truth comes first. Then the Treta, the Dvapara, and the Kali. In the Puranas each of these ages runs from 432,000 to 1,728,000 years. This is the told past, not the dated one, and it has a geography of its own. In the Treta, Rama rules from Ayodhya. Where the Dvapara meets the Kali, the armies of the Mahabharata gather at Kurukshetra. What follows is tradition, and it is told as tradition.", "sarvam:varun_en_suspense@en-IN", "+6%", "+0Hz", null, 1.0, 0.0, "v3"]
